charts.title: TOI-756 b: orbits around TOI-756
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-756's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-756 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Parc et al. 2025 (2025A&A...702A.138P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname PARC_ET_AL__2025): P 1.2392495 d

charts.title: TOI-756 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-756 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (37, 64, 100) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 73649615, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 4 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 4 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 4-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 4 min late; 4-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 1 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
